units: net returns: 2025 USD per acre per year over the whole rotation, fallow acres included; K-State budget of the county's region with land rent; insurance and government payments excluded. mean_before_land_rent adds the region's rent back (nearly the same for every rotation of a county, within a few dollars)
yield_level: Model yields scaled per county and crop to the mean USDA NASS non-irrigated county yield (engine/county_yield_factors.json)
caution: County centroids are not fields. Weather and soil at one point stand for the whole county. Indicative only.

agreement_with_practice.note: Counties where WF, WSF and WCF together cover at least 5% of the classified field area. Most common = largest share of area among the three; model = highest mean net return among the three.

sorghum instead of fallow (WSF vs WF).note: rank correlation between the model's gain of WSF over WF and farmers' share of WSF among WSF+WF

corn instead of sorghum (WCF vs WSF).note: rank correlation between the model's gain of WCF over WSF and farmers' share of WCF among WCF+WSF

leaving fallow since 2008.note: Fallow share of dryland cropland 2008 -> latest CDL year (counties.geojson) and fields that moved from wheat-fallow to a three-year rotation (county_field_rotations.json). A positive value would mean farmers left fallow where the model sees the largest gain.
